question: Do the two selected decision-only adapters express their paired choices and explanations when generation begins at the exact common trained prefix instead of choosing the opening JSON serialization?

cohort.selection: all 40 rows with kind=review, preserving all 20 concern/clean pairs in original dataset order

models.selected_update: chosen by the unchanged selector among updates 25, 50, 100 before generation

intervention.original_prompt: Each row's exact system/user messages in the existing ChatML serialization; no wording or task change.
intervention.choice: The supplied prefix contains no colon, array, finding, line ID, or reason. The model generates the remaining JSON and chooses empty versus nonempty findings.

decoding.sharding: Two fixed shards per model: filtered review indices 0,2,...,38 and 1,3,...,39, 20 prompts each. Join by case ID.

checks_before_each_shard_generates: Hash the actual model and require every corresponding natural output record to name that SHA-256.

Reconstruct all 40 natural ChatML prompts and require exact SHA-256 agreement with the prior natural outputs, plus matching context, temperature, token budget, floating activations, and two-thread settings.
Use the native runner --token-ids on every selected original prompt and supplied-prefix prompt; assert supplied IDs equal original IDs followed by exactly [4913,3903,819].
Tokenize each complete gold answer through the native runner and require the same supplied-prefix ID boundary plus its expected first divergent target ID.
Require complete 20-pair membership before splitting shards; create outputs exclusively without overwriting.
comparison: Join the two model arms by case ID and require their original/supplied prompt text hashes and native ID arrays to agree.
Score complete generated JSON as empty or nonempty findings, preserve parse failures, then count complete concern/clean pairs across all 20 pairs.
Assess changed-line citations and reason meaning separately, retaining raw continuation and assembled response.
Compare supplied-prefix outcomes with the matching natural outputs and the existing teacher-forced decision metrics.
first_token_reporting: Do not infer the emitted first token by re-tokenizing continuation text. This probe reports complete generated findings presence; teacher-forced target-token winners remain the separate existing metric.
execution: From repository root: node ../reference/probe_shared_prefix.mjs MODEL.gguf MATCHING_NATURAL.jsonl NEW_OUTPUT.jsonl --shard 0 (repeat with --shard 1 for each selected model)
scope: Scratch native-inference diagnostic; production prompts, model lock, training objective, native source, and checkpoint selector stay as declared.
